tasks.title: Set Up Observability Stack
tasks.description: Completed observability stack implementation with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Tempo. Production-ready monitoring with comprehensive dashboards, tracing, and log aggregation.
tasks.details:
Deployed full observability stack including:
- Prometheus with service discovery, Kubernetes integration, custom alerting rules for CPU/memory/errors/circuit breakers, and database/Redis monitoring
- Grafana with Prometheus/Loki/Tempo datasources, DevOps E2E dashboards, service health metrics, and database/Redis monitoring
- Loki for centralized log aggregation with efficient storage and Grafana integration
- Tempo for distributed tracing with Jaeger/Zipkin/OTLP support and service graph generation
- OpenTelemetry Collector for centralized telemetry processing
- Updated docker-compose.yml with full stack integration
- Monitoring setup script for automated deployment
tasks.testStrategy:
Verify all components are accessible via:
- Grafana: http://localhost:3001 (admin/admin)
- Prometheus: http://localhost:9090
- Loki: http://localhost:3100
- Tempo: http://localhost:3200
- OpenTelemetry Collector: http://localhost:13133
Validate metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards are fully functional

tasks.title: Implement Blue-Green Deployment
tasks.description: Blue-Green deployment implementation completed for production environment
tasks.details:
Comprehensive blue-green deployment with:
- Separate namespaces for blue (stable) and green (preview) environments
- Complete deployment configurations for API Gateway in both environments
- Traffic router with nginx configuration for traffic switching
- Health checks and readiness probes for all services
- Zero-downtime deployment strategy
- Automated traffic switching between environments
- Rollback capabilities
- Integration testing in green environment
- Comprehensive deployment pipeline
tasks.testStrategy: Validate automated traffic switching, health checks, rollback capabilities, and integration testing in green environment. Verify deployment pipeline stages including CI/CD automation and monitoring.

tasks.title: Fix GitHub Actions Workflow Errors
tasks.description: Verify and validate the resolution of GitHub Actions workflow errors through comprehensive testing and confirmation of stable pipeline execution
tasks.details:
1. Confirm all disabled workflow files have been removed to prevent parsing conflicts
2. Validate YAML syntax for all workflows (minimal.yml, simple.yml, test.yml, ci.yml, security.yml) to ensure proper structure
3. Verify removal of complex secrets syntax and problematic references
4. Confirm workflows are configured to run on relevant branches/events without 'No jobs were run' errors
5. Execute all workflows in production environment to validate stability
6. Implement monitoring for workflow execution and error tracking
7. Document workflow configurations and validation results
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Execute all workflows (minimal.yml, simple.yml, test.yml, ci.yml, security.yml) to confirm successful execution
2. Validate that all service jobs (4 service jobs, security scan, Docker builds) complete without errors
3. Confirm security scanning workflows (CodeQL, dependency scan, container scan, SAST) produce expected results
4. Verify pipeline triggers correctly for relevant events and branches
5. Monitor workflow execution logs for any unexpected behavior or errors
